project_type: pnpm monorepo: Next.js 14 web app (App Router) + Discord.js bot (Sapphire framework) + BullMQ worker
build_system: pnpm workspaces, Next.js builds web, tsc builds packages. No build command defined for bot/worker (they run in dev mode or deployed directly).
test_framework: No test framework configured in package.json files explored
build_command: pnpm --recursive build (builds all packages and web app)
test_command: pnpm --recursive test (configured but no test files found)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `pnpm --filter @esports/database exec -- prisma format` after schema changes. 2. Run `pnpm --filter @esports/database exec -- prisma generate` to regenerate Prisma client. 3. Run `pnpm --filter web dev` and navigate to /servers/[guildId]/developer to verify the page loads. 4. Test API routes with curl or Postman ensuring auth headers are present. 5. Check bot logs for command execution and error recording.
snapshot_or_generated_files: packages/database/src/generated/client/* is generated by prisma generate after schema changes. This must be regenerated and committed.
environment_constraints: Auth requires Supabase session cookies. API routes use withPermission(AppRole.SERVER_ADMIN) for auth. Bot uses Sapphire framework with Command base class. Worker runs BullMQ jobs with reconciliation loop every 60s.
contribution_requirements: Per operations-runbook.md: health endpoint at /api/health checks database, redis, and outboxBacklog. Must maintain existing patterns. Do not modify existing models/enums unless required.
key_patterns: 1. API routes: use withPermission(requiredRole, handler) where handler receives {userId, guildId, role, isOwner, params}. 2. Bot commands: extend Command from @sapphire/framework, register via registerApplicationCommands. 3. Bot listeners: extend Listener from @sapphire/framework. 4. Dashboard pages: async Server Components, prisma queries inline, pass data to 'use client' components. 5. UI: GlassCard for containers, AnimatedCounter for numbers, recharts for charts, @radix-ui/react-tabs for tabs. 6. Outbox pattern: OutboxEvent table stores events with status PENDING/DELIVERED/FAILED, worker reconciles every 60s.
directory_structure: packages/database (Prisma schema + generated client), packages/permissions (withPermission auth HOC), apps/web (Next.js 14 App Router), apps/discord-bot (Discord.js + Sapphire), apps/worker (BullMQ worker). Web pages: apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/<page>/page.tsx. API routes: apps/web/src/app/api/servers/[guildId]/<endpoint>/route.ts. Bot commands: apps/discord-bot/src/commands/<command>.ts. Bot listeners: apps/discord-bot/src/listeners/<event>.ts. UI components: apps/web/src/components/ui/<Component>.tsx.
